In src/sqllens/tools/_format.py components_to_blocks, other things reach the rendered blocks: (1) one-row DataFrames become 'result_text' candidates (lines 375-377) emitted unconditionally as public text blocks (498-501), with no marker; (2) the backwards-compat fallback (496-497) includes the last unmarked TEXT when no marked TEXT exists, so an unmarked producer reaches the answer.
